blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Lawmakers have been urged to approve a bill that would allow lower fees for overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) sending remittances, so that their families can cope with the rising cost of goods and services. In a statement, Parañaque Rep. Brian Raymund Yamsuan said that House Bill (HB) No. 8615, or the proposed Overseas Filipino Workers’ Remittance Protection Act can provide OFW families with savings, as key agencies will be tasked to set the minimum possible range of remittance fees and other related charges.
